title: FTSE Russell US indexes — the first December semi-annual reconstitution, implemented after the close
source: EST: owner-published date, filed estimate because a proposal is always estimate by contract and this calendar's confirmed-tier prefixes have no member for an index owner. FTSE Russell's own reconstitution page, lseg.com/en/ftse-russell/russell-reconstitution, fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 228,333 bytes, 13,681 characters of extracted text), states the date twice and verbatim: "The newly reconstituted indexes take effect after US market close on December 11", and in its FAQ "The newly reconstituted indexes take effect after the market close on December 11, 2026." The same page gives the surrounding schedule: "the rank day for the December reconstitution falls on Friday, October 30" and "Preliminary lists for the upcoming December 2026 Reconstitution will be communicated beginning November 13, with updates on November 20, November 27, December 4, and December 11." INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCED FROM THE RULE, not just read off the page: FTSE Russell, "Russell US Equity Indexes" construction and methodology, v7.2, August 2026 (lseg.com dam PDF, HTTP 200, 746,491 bytes, text-extracted in-session), section 4.2.3 -- "Reconstitution occurs on the fourth Friday in June and the second Friday in December" -- and Appendix F's schedule table, Implementation = "2nd Friday of December", Rank Day = "Last business day of October", Preliminary Information Released = "Four weeks prior to implementation". December 2026's Fridays are 12-04 / 12-11 / 12-18 / 12-25, so the second is 2026-12-11; October 2026's last business day is Friday 10-30; and 2026-11-13 to 2026-12-11 is exactly 28 days, matching the four-week rule to the day. Appendix F also defines implementation: "the day changes are made after the close of the market and become effective at the open on the Monday following" -- so the changes are effective at the open Monday 2026-12-14. Promote to confirmed when this calendar gains a prefix for an index owner's own published schedule. Discovered during the russell-reconstitution-2027-06-25 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the russell-reconstitution-2027-06-25 initial research (2026-09-06). WHY IT MATTERS TO THE PROPOSER, and why it is filed at 96 days out rather than left as a footnote on a 292-day-out event: this is the FIRST December reconstitution in the Russell US index family's history. FTSE Russell moved from annual (June only) to semi-annual (June and December) reconstitution beginning in 2026 -- ground rules v7.2 section 4.2.3, and the owner's page verbatim, "Beginning in 2026, the Russell Indexes are reconstituted semi-annually, in June and December." Every base rate anyone holds about Russell reconstitution, including the ten June windows the proposer measured, describes a regime in which June carried a full year of membership drift alone. 2026-12-11 is the first observation of how that turnover actually splits, and it is therefore the single most informative dated event for the proposer's own June 2027 stance -- which is why the proposer registered it as a scored forward test (FT-russell-reconstitution-2027-06-25-1) rather than merely noting it. THE CORRIDOR IS THE REASON FOR MEDIUM RATHER THAN LOW: 2026-12-11 is already the date of two `high` entries this calendar carries -- cr-expiry-2026-12-11 and government-funding-deadline-2026-12-11 -- one day after cpi-2026-12-10 (high) and two days after fomc-2026-12-09 (high). A mechanically forced closing auction landing on a government-funding deadline is worth a session's attention even though nothing about it is tradeable here. THAT COLLISION ALSO CUTS THE OTHER WAY, and the proposer states it rather than hiding it: it confounds any volume-based read of the recon's size on that date, so a HIGH volume print on 2026-12-11 is uninformative about reconstitution and only a LOW one is informative. WHAT THE PROPOSER MEASURED as the before-picture: under the annual regime, December's second Friday was an ordinary session -- no reconstitution, no expiration, no quarter-end -- printing IWM whole-day volume at a mean 1.14x / median 1.08x of its trailing-60d median across 2016-2025 (max 1.57x), against June recon days' 1.42x median (1.33x excluding the 2016 Brexit session). Impact medium, status estimate: it widens caution about the 2026-12-11 close and licenses nothing, and no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (re-grepped 2026-09-06, zero hits). Kind `sector` matches the sibling market-structure flow entries; the enum has no index-flow member and the imperfect fit is named, not fixed from this lane.
